newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases ahead holiday, on central bank rates.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases ahead holiday, on central bank rates.

text.p: The rouble eased after the central bank lowered its intervention rates, and dealers said commercial banks were seeking dollars for excess rouble funds ahead of the Constitution Day holidays.
Thursday and Friday are market holidays in Russia, and Saturday and Sunday are working days.
roubles/dollar Dec 11 midday Dec 11 early Dec 10 close
Dealers said banks, which had spare roubles, preferred to invest them in dollars to avoid losses during the holidays.
"(In early trading) there was a sort of vacuum between rouble offer and demand," a Stolichny Bank dealer said.
"Some banks offered roubles at exaggerated rates, but they were finding no demand as there were others anticipating that roubles will be cheap leading up to the holidays."

Another dealer said rouble supply had started growing on Tuesday, and the dollar firmed further on Wednesday after the central bank raised its dollar offer rate by 10 points, compared with usual daily rate changes of one to three points.
